Which statement about mass and weight is correct?
A
Mass is a property that causes change in motion.
B
Mass is caused by a gravitational field acting on a weight.
C
Weight is a property that resists change in motion.
D
Weight is caused by a gravitational field acting on a mass.

options.label: A
options.text: Mass is a property that causes change in motion.

options.label: B
options.text: Mass is caused by a gravitational field acting on a weight.

options.label: C
options.text: Weight is a property that resists change in motion.

options.label: D
options.text: Weight is caused by a gravitational field acting on a mass.
